swo.label: Skill 1: Subject & Verb
swo.desc: Menerangkan variasi Subject, Verb, beserta kesesuaian keduanya.

swo.label: Skill 2 : Preposition
swo.desc: Menerangkan fungsi Preposisi sebagai modifier, adverb, atau Appositive, serta posisinya dalam kalimat.

swo.label: Skill 3 : Appositive
swo.desc: Menerangkan fungsi Appositive sebagai informasi tambahan dari Noun atau Pronoun beserta posisi dan variasinya.

swo.label: Skill 4 & 5 : Participle
swo.desc: Bentuk Participle, fungsinya, serta perbedaan dengan Gerund

swo.label: Skill 6 : Coordinating Conjunction
swo.desc: Menerangkan bentuk kata yang menghubungkan element yang setara (FANBOYS), parallel structure, dan Subject proximity.

swo.label: Skill 7 : Subordinating Conjunction
swo.desc: Menerangkan kata hubung antar clause (Main Clause & Subclause), tipe-tipe konjungsi, posisi, dan peringkasannya.

swo.label: Skill 8 : Correlative Conjunction
swo.desc: Menjelaskan bentuk konjungsi yang selalu berpasangan, Subject Proximity, dan aturan Inversi.

swo.label: Skill 9 : Noun Clause
swo.desc: Menjelaskan bentuk Clause yang berfungsi seperti noun, variasi, dan reduksinya.

swo.label: Skill 10 : Adjective Clause
swo.desc: Menjelaskan Clause yang berfungsi untuk menerangkan Noun atau Pronoun, Variasi, dan pola reduksinya.

swo.label: Skill 11 : AC Reduction
swo.desc: Penghapusan elemen-elemen tertentu pada Adjective Clause (AC), konsekuensi penghapusan, dan strukturnya.

swo.label: Skill 12 : AVC Reduction
swo.desc: Penghapusan elemen-element tertentu yang terjadi dalam Adverbial Clause (AVC), konsekuensi, beserta hasil akhirnya.

swo.label: Skill 13 : Inversion in Question
swo.desc: Perubahan posisi Subject dan Kata Kerja Bantu pada struktur tertentu.

swo.label: Skill 14 : Inversion of Place Expression
swo.desc: Perubahan posisi Subject dan Kata Kerjanya setelah ekspresi tertentu yang menunjukkan Tempat dan Arah.

swo.label: Skill 15 : Inversion of Negative Expression
swo.desc: Perubahan posisi Subject dan Kata Kerjanya setelah ekspresi Negative tertentu pada sebuah klausa atau kalimat.

swo.label: Skill 16 : Inversion in Conditional Sentence
swo.desc: Menjelaskan bentuk inversi yang terjadi pada Conditional Sentence (Type 1, 2, 3).

swo.label: Skill 17 : Inversion in Comparison
swo.desc: Inversi yang terjadi pada Subject dan Auxiliary-nya dalam Comparison.

listening-skill1.audioScript: Woman: Have you finished the report for Professor Allen? Man: Almost. I still need to check the figures in the final section. Woman: The professor said he would like to receive it before noon tomorrow. Man: That should be fine. I will review it tonight and send it first thing in the morning. Woman: Great. Let me know if you need me to check anything.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
o: A report that needs to be completed
questions.e: They discuss checking the figures and submitting the report before the deadline.

questions.q: What does the man still need to do?
questions.e: He says he still needs to check the figures in the final section.

questions.q: When does the professor want to receive the report?
questions.e: The woman says the professor wants it before noon tomorrow.

questions.q: The committee _____ the final decision yesterday.
questions.e: The time expression 'yesterday' requires the simple past: made.

questions.q: The new library, _____ last year, is already popular with students.
questions.e: The past participle 'completed' works as a reduced passive adjective clause.

questions.q: Neither the students nor the teacher _____ aware of the schedule change.
questions.e: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'Teacher' is singular, so use was.

questions.q: The researcher collected the data carefully, _____ the results were reliable.
questions.e: 'So' introduces the result: careful collection led to reliable results.

questions.q: Rapid technological changes in modern offices _____ many traditional administrative tasks.
questions.e: Subject jamak "changes" membutuhkan verb plural dasar "change"

questions.q: _____ on the wooden shelf belongs to my grandmother.
questions.e: Kalimat membutuhkan subject tunggal utama sebelum verb tunggal "belongs"

questions.q: A quiet library in the afternoon _____ a perfect place for studying English grammar.
questions.e: Subjek tunggal "A quiet library" memerlukan verb tunggal "provides"

questions.q: Running three kilometers every single morning _____ good for cardiovascular health.
questions.e: Gerund sebagai subjek dianggap tunggal, sehingga verb-nya adalah is

questions.q: Across the wide green valley _____ a small historical village.
questions.e: Inversi tempat: subjek tunggal "a small historical village" berada di belakang, sehingga verb tunggalnya adalah lies

questions.q: Several boxes of chocolate cookies _____ on the kitchen counter.
questions.e: Inti subjek jamak "Several boxes" memerlukan verb jamak sit

reading-skill1.passage: Urban trees provide benefits that extend beyond their appearance. Their leaves can provide shade, reducing the amount of heat absorbed by streets and buildings. Trees also help manage rainwater: some water is intercepted by leaves, while roots can improve the soil's ability to absorb rainfall. In addition, urban vegetation creates habitats for birds and insects. However, planting trees in cities requires careful planning. Species must be selected according to local climate, available space, and maintenance needs. A tree that grows well in a park may not be suitable for a narrow sidewalk where roots could damage pavement or underground pipes. Therefore, successful urban forestry depends not simply on planting more trees, but on choosing appropriate species and caring for them over time.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
o: Why cities should remove old trees
The benefits of urban trees and the need for careful planning
Why all tree species grow well on sidewalks
questions.e: The passage describes several benefits and explains why tree selection and maintenance matter.

questions.q: According to the passage, how can trees help manage rainwater?
o: By intercepting water and improving soil absorption
questions.e: The passage states that leaves intercept some water and roots can improve soil absorption.

questions.q: The word 'intercepted' is closest in meaning to _____.
questions.e: In context, leaves catch or hold some of the rainwater.

questions.q: Why might a tree be unsuitable for a narrow sidewalk?
o: It may attract too many birds
Its roots may damage pavement or pipes
questions.e: The passage specifically mentions possible damage from roots.

questions.q: The quality of the products manufactured in this factory _____ significantly improved over the past decade.
questions.e: Explanation: Subject utama adalah the quality, yang berbentuk singular. Of the products manufactured in this factory merupakan prepositional phrase yang memodifikasi noun quality. Noun products tidak menjadi subject sehingga verb harus singular (has).

questions.q: The students in the English department _____ required to submit their assignments before Friday.
The number of participants in the international conference _____ increased considerably this year.
The amount of information collected during the investigation _____ too large for the researchers to analyze manually.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah the amount, yang singular. Prepositional phrase of information collected during the investigation memodifikasi noun amount. Oleh karena itu, verb yang digunakan adalah was.
questions.topic: Subject-Verb Agreement; Prepositional Phrase as Noun Modifier

questions.q: Each of the participants in the international seminar _____ a certificate after completing the program.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah each, yang selalu singular dalam pola each of + plural noun. Frasa of the participants in the international seminar tidak menentukan agreement verb. Oleh karena itu, verb yang tepat adalah receives.

questions.q: The majority of the students in the advanced linguistics class _____ completed their research proposals.
questions.e: Dalam konteks ini, the majority of the students mengacu pada sejumlah mahasiswa (plural), sehingga verb plural have digunakan. Frasa in the advanced linguistics class memodifikasi noun students.

questions.q: The students who participate in the activities of the student organization _____ responsible for organizing the annual event.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah the students (plural). Relative clause who participate in the activities of the student organization menjelaskan students. Verb utama are harus sesuai dengan subject plural.
questions.topic: Subject-Verb Agreement; Relative Clause; Noun Modifier

questions.q: Many of the books in the collection of historical documents _____ written by prominent Indonesian scholars.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah many, yang plural. Frasa of the books in the collection of historical documents menjelaskan many. Verb yang tepat adalah were.

questions.q: In addition to the information provided in the textbook, _____ useful for understanding the theoretical framework of the study.
questions.e: Kalimat membutuhkan subject dan verb. Several supplementary articles merupakan subject plural, sedangkan are adalah verb. Frasa In addition to the information provided in the textbook merupakan introductory prepositional phrase dan bukan subject kalimat.
questions.topic: Sentence Structure; Subject and Verb; Prepositional Phrase

questions.q: The two methods of teaching English to young learners _____ different advantages and disadvantages.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah the two methods, yang plural. Frasa of teaching English to young learners memodifikasi noun methods. Verb yang tepat adalah have.
questions.topic: Subject-Verb Agreement; Prepositional Phrase as Noun Modifier

questions.q: Alexander Graham Bell, _____, is widely recognized for his contributions to the development of the telephone.
questions.e: The inventor of the telephone merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan subject Alexander Graham Bell. Appositive berupa noun phrase dan tidak membutuhkan conjunction atau relative pronoun.

questions.q: The principal of the university, _____, announced the new academic policy yesterday.
questions.e: An experienced educator merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan the principal of the university. Karena appositive hanya memberikan informasi tambahan, subject utama tetap the principal, sehingga verb utama announced tidak berubah.

questions.q: _____, the capital of Indonesia, is located on the island of Java.
questions.e: The capital of Indonesia merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan noun Jakarta. Appositive diletakkan setelah subject dan diapit koma. Struktur kalimatnya adalah Jakarta, the capital of Indonesia, is located...

questions.q: The novel _____ became one of the most influential literary works of the twentieth century.
o: Animal Farm, a political satire by George Orwell,
Animal Farm a political satire by George Orwell
Animal Farm, was a political satire by George Orwell,
Animal Farm which a political satire by George Orwell
questions.e: A political satire by George Orwell merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan Animal Farm. Karena appositive berada di antara subject dan verb, frasa tersebut harus diapit oleh koma. Subject utama tetap The novel Animal Farm, sehingga verb became digunakan.
questions.topic: Appositive; Appositive between Subject and Verb

questions.q: My brother, _____, has recently graduated from medical school.
o: a student of medicine for six years
who a student of medicine for six years
studying medicine for six years was
has been a student of medicine for six years
questions.e: A student of medicine for six years merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan my brother. Appositive berupa noun phrase, bukan finite clause, sehingga tidak memerlukan verb utama tambahan.

questions.q: The Amazon River, _____, flows through several South American countries.
o: the longest river in the world by volume
which the longest river in the world by volume
is the longest river in the world by volume
flowing the longest river in the world by volume
questions.e: The longest river in the world by volume merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan The Amazon River. Appositive ditempatkan setelah subject dan diapit koma.

questions.q: _____, a famous Indonesian independence leader, played an important role in the struggle for independence.
questions.e: A famous Indonesian independence leader merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan Soekarno. Subject utama adalah Soekarno, sehingga verb played digunakan untuk melengkapi kalimat.

questions.q: The discovery of penicillin, _____, revolutionized modern medicine.
o: an important breakthrough in medical science
was an important breakthrough in medical science
which an important breakthrough in medical science
being an important breakthrough in medical science
questions.e: An important breakthrough in medical science merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan the discovery of penicillin. Subject utama adalah the discovery, singular, sehingga verb revolutionized tetap digunakan.

questions.q: The professor of linguistics, _____, has published several books on language acquisition.
o: who an expert in second-language learning
is an expert in second-language learning
questions.e: An expert in second-language learning merupakan appositive noun phrase yang menjelaskan the professor of linguistics. Subject utama adalah the professor, sehingga verb singular has published tepat.

questions.q: _____, the largest planet in the solar system, has dozens of moons.
questions.e: The largest planet in the solar system merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan Jupiter. Appositive diletakkan setelah subject dan diapit koma. Subject dan verb utama adalah Jupiter has.

questions.q: The committee members, _____, agreed to revise the proposal.
o: who representatives of several academic departments
questions.e: Representatives of several academic departments merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan the committee members. Subject utama adalah committee members, sedangkan appositive tidak memengaruhi verb agreed.

questions.q: The city of Bandung, _____, is known for its educational institutions and creative industries.
o: a major urban center in West Java
which a major urban center in West Java
being a major urban center in West Java is
a major urban center in West Java it
questions.e: A major urban center in West Java merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan the city of Bandung. Appositive berada di antara subject dan verb, sehingga diapit koma. Subject utama adalah the city of Bandung.
questions.topic: Appositive; Appositive between Subject and Verb

questions.q: _____, the founder of the Indonesian language movement, contributed significantly to the development of Indonesian nationalism.
questions.e: The founder of the Indonesian language movement merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan Ki Hajar Dewantara. Subject utama adalah nama tokoh tersebut, sehingga verb contributed melengkapi kalimat.

questions.q: The two researchers, _____, published their findings in an international journal.
o: being experts in computational linguistics published
questions.e: Experts in computational linguistics merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan the two researchers. Appositive harus sesuai secara makna dengan noun yang dijelaskan. Karena subject researchers plural, bentuk experts tepat.

questions.q: _____, a collection of traditional Indonesian stories, contains numerous moral lessons.
questions.e: A collection of traditional Indonesian stories merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan the book. Subject utama the book singular, sehingga verb contains digunakan.

questions.q: The students _____ in the language laboratory are preparing for their listening examination.
questions.e: Practicing in the language laboratory merupakan present participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun students. Frasa tersebut merupakan reduced adjective clause dari students who are practicing. Karena blank memerlukan modifier, bukan main verb, practicing adalah jawaban yang tepat.
questions.topic: Present Participle; Noun Modifier; Reduced Adjective Clause

questions.q: The research findings _____ by the university's faculty members were published in an international journal.
questions.e: Analyzed by the university's faculty members merupakan past participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun research findings. Struktur ini merupakan reduced passive adjective clause: the research findings which were analyzed by the university's faculty members. Main verb kalimat adalah were published.
questions.topic: Past Participle; Reduced Passive Adjective Clause

questions.q: _____ the effects of climate change, the researchers collected data from several coastal regions.
questions.e: Investigating the effects of climate change merupakan present participial phrase yang berfungsi sebagai adverbial, menjelaskan aktivitas yang dilakukan researchers. Subject participial phrase harus sama dengan subject main clause, yaitu the researchers.

questions.q: The lecture _____ by the visiting professor attracted hundreds of students.
questions.e: Delivered by the visiting professor merupakan past participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun lecture. Karena lecture menerima tindakan (disampaikan), digunakan past participle delivered. Main verb kalimat adalah attracted.

questions.q: _____ the instructions carefully, the students were able to complete the experiment successfully.
questions.e: Following the instructions carefully merupakan present participial phrase yang berfungsi sebagai adverbial of manner atau circumstances. Subject-nya adalah the students, yang melakukan tindakan mengikuti instruksi.

questions.q: The book _____ on the table contains several useful examples of grammatical structures.
questions.e: Lying on the table merupakan present participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun book. Kata lying berasal dari verb lie (berada/terletak), bukan lay (meletakkan sesuatu). Main verb kalimat adalah contains.
questions.topic: Present Participle; Noun Modifier; Verb Forms

questions.q: _____ by the sudden announcement, the employees immediately began discussing the new policy.
questions.e: Surprised by the sudden announcement merupakan past participial phrase yang menjelaskan kondisi employees. Employees menerima efek kejutan, sehingga past participle surprised digunakan. Subject main clause adalah the employees.

questions.q: The _____ water in the laboratory was immediately discarded because it was contaminated.
questions.e: Contaminated merupakan past participle yang berfungsi sebagai adjective, memodifikasi noun water. Water menerima tindakan kontaminasi, sehingga past participle tepat. Blank berada sebelum noun, sebagai attributive adjective.

questions.q: The woman _____ near the entrance is the director of the research institute.
questions.e: Standing near the entrance merupakan present participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun the woman. Frasa ini berasal dari the woman who is standing near the entrance. Main verb kalimat adalah is.

questions.q: _____ the historical documents, the researcher discovered several previously unknown facts about the region.
questions.e: Examining the historical documents merupakan present participial phrase yang berfungsi sebagai adverbial. Subject-nya adalah the researcher, yang melakukan tindakan examining. Bentuk examined tidak tepat karena akan memberikan makna pasif.
questions.topic: Present Participle; Adverbial Function; Active Voice

questions.q: The equipment _____ in the laboratory must be handled with extreme care.
questions.e: Used in the laboratory merupakan past participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun equipment. Equipment menerima tindakan penggunaan, sehingga bentuk pasif used tepat. Main verb kalimat adalah must be handled.
questions.topic: Past Participle; Reduced Passive Clause; Noun Modifier

questions.q: _____ by the complexity of the problem, the students requested additional guidance from their instructor.
questions.e: Confused by the complexity of the problem merupakan past participial phrase yang menjelaskan keadaan students. Students mengalami kebingungan, bukan menyebabkan kebingungan. Oleh karena itu, confused digunakan.

questions.q: The man _____ the documents to the administrative office is a new employee.
questions.e: Submitting the documents to the administrative office merupakan present participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun the man. Frasa tersebut menjelaskan man yang sedang melakukan tindakan submitting. Main verb kalimat adalah is.
questions.topic: Present Participle; Noun Modifier; Reduced Adjective Clause

questions.q: The _____ students were asked to leave the examination room immediately.
questions.e: Cheating merupakan present participle yang berfungsi sebagai adjective, memodifikasi noun students. Students melakukan tindakan cheating, sehingga present participle digunakan. Blank berada sebelum noun, bukan sebagai main verb.

questions.q: The professor's _____ of the students' essays took several hours to complete.
questions.e: Blank membutuhkan noun yang berfungsi sebagai subject dari took. Evaluation adalah noun, sedangkan evaluating dapat berfungsi sebagai gerund. Dalam struktur the professor's evaluation of the students' essays, bentuk noun evaluation lebih tepat untuk menyatakan proses atau hasil penilaian. Perhatikan bahwa gerund dan participle sama-sama dapat berbentuk -ing, tetapi fungsinya berbeda.
questions.topic: Gerund vs. Participle; Noun Function; Word Form

questions.q: The professor encouraged students to read academic journals, _____ participate in research conferences, and publish their findings.
questions.e: Conjunction and menghubungkan tiga parallel verb phrases: read academic journals, participate in research conferences, dan publish their findings. Ketiganya menggunakan base form verb karena mengikuti pola infinitive tanpa to setelah encouraged students to.

questions.q: The economic development of a country depends not only on its natural resources _____ on the quality of its human capital.
questions.e: Pola not only ... but also digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua elemen yang setara. On its natural resources sejajar dengan on the quality of its human capital. Kata but also melengkapi pasangan conjunction not only.

questions.q: The new policy aims to improve the quality of education, ______ administrative costs, and increase student participation.
questions.e: And menghubungkan tiga parallel verb phrases: improve, reduce, dan increase. Ketiganya harus menggunakan base form agar struktur sejajar.

questions.q: The success of the program depends on effective communication, adequate funding, _____ strong institutional support.
questions.e: And menghubungkan tiga parallel noun phrases: effective communication, adequate funding, dan strong institutional support. Ketiganya berfungsi sebagai objek preposition on.

questions.q: _____ the students and the lecturers were required to attend the academic seminar.
questions.e: Both ... and digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua subject, yaitu the students dan the lecturers. Karena keduanya plural, verb yang digunakan adalah were.

questions.q: Learning a foreign language requires memorizing vocabulary, understanding grammatical structures, and _______ pronunciation regularly.
questions.e: And menghubungkan tiga parallel gerund phrases: memorizing vocabulary, understanding grammatical structures, dan practicing pronunciation regularly. Ketiganya berfungsi sebagai objek dari verb requires.

questions.q: The experiment was repeated several times, _____ the initial results were inconsistent.
questions.e: For merupakan coordinating conjunction yang menunjukkan reason atau explanation. Klausa kedua menjelaskan alasan mengapa experiment diulang. Dalam konteks ini, for memiliki fungsi yang mirip dengan because, tetapi secara grammatical menghubungkan independent clauses.

questions.q: The students were expected to analyze the data objectively, interpret the findings accurately, _____ present their conclusions logically.
The principal, together with the teachers and administrative staff, _____ responsible for maintaining the academic standards of the institution.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah the principal, yang singular. Frasa together with the teachers and administrative staff tidak membentuk compound subject dan tidak mengubah agreement. Verb yang tepat adalah is.
questions.topic: Subject-Verb Agreement; Compound Modifier; Noun Phrase

questions.q: The professor and the research assistant _____ responsible for preparing the presentation and organizing the supporting materials.
questions.e: Subject the professor and the research assistant merupakan compound subject yang dihubungkan dengan and, sehingga plural. Verb yang tepat adalah are. Parallelism juga terlihat pada preparing the presentation dan organizing the supporting materials.

questions.q: She _____ to school every day.
questions.e: With a third-person singular subject in the simple present, add -s: goes.

questions.q: There are _____ books on the table.
questions.e: 'Books' is countable, so use 'many'.

questions.q: My brother is taller _____ me.
questions.e: Comparatives use 'than'.

questions.q: The report _____ by the committee before the deadline.
questions.e: The report receives the action, so use the passive: was submitted.

questions.q: Not only _____ the exam, but she also received a scholarship.
questions.e: After 'Not only' at the start of a clause, the auxiliary comes before the subject.

questions.q: The professor, along with his students, _____ attending the conference.
questions.e: The subject is 'professor' (singular); 'along with ...' does not change the verb.

questions.q: Had the committee reviewed the proposal earlier, the errors _____ avoided.
questions.e: A third conditional (inverted) needs 'would have + past participle' in the result clause.

questions.q: The more carefully you read, _____ you will understand.
questions.e: The double comparative structure is 'the more..., the better...'.

questions.q: Rarely _____ such a remarkable performance.
questions.e: A negative adverb at the start of a sentence triggers subject–auxiliary inversion.
